d: In this video Firstpost explains how Kylie Jenner is facing her fourth lawsuit from a former household employee in just seven months. A former housekeeper has accused the reality TV star, her companies and staff of workplace discrimination, retaliation and labour violations. The allegations include being trapped inside Jenner’s walk-in closet for over an hour, bitten by a dog and accidentally exposed to pepper spray.
